_note: Test vectors for robofast_core/devices/adc_math.py: the FLWO 60-inch legacy ADC daemon (adc_d, telshell, T. Groner; with thanks to FLWO).

Generated by compiling the legacy functions (get_pa, adj_deg, the zenith-distance table, the production target formula and the adc_todegree conversion) unchanged in a small C harness, with SOFA iauHd2pa/iauTf2a; latitude 31.69 deg as hard-coded in the legacy code.

Inputs: ha and dec strings as the legacy status reader writes them, zd (deg) as it reads it. Outputs: pa (deg), defl (deg), atarg/btarg (prism angles, deg), a_deg/b_deg (motor angles from home, deg; float32 in the legacy code), a_steps/b_steps (the steps sent with ma).
